events.title: Office Store Restocked: New Items and Fixes
events.summary: THE OFFICE STORE HAS BEEN RESTOCKED The office store has a larger perk pool — and HR probably should not have approved half of it. Every match now brings a different combination of six items, giving you more ways to survive the shift or quietly ruin someone else's. Six new consumables Corporate meal voucher — remove 2 Stress from yourself. Paid day off — gain 3 Patience. Counselling session — remove 1 Stress and gain 1 Patience. Vending-machine energy drink — gain 2 Patience, but also 1 Stress.

events.title: Major Visual Update: Welcome to the New Office
events.summary: A MAJOR VISUAL UPDATE We have rebuilt the shared screen of Last One Employed. The rules and office politics remain familiar, but the match now does a much better job of showing what just happened, whose turn it is, and who has attracted too much attention from their former coworkers. The game table is now the center of the match The inbox deck, latest played card, discard pile, and shop now live together on one physical office table. events.title: The Free Demo Is Available Now!
events.summary: THE FREE DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW! The free demo for Last One Employed is available now. Host the game on one PC, let friends join with their phones, and fight through office politics, risky cards, and a corporate party where only one employee can remain. What the demo includes Your group can start one complete 25-minute party with the demo edition's roles and cards. Play + Wishlist Download the demo now, then wishlist the full game so you are ready for release.
